scope: Reconcile the first post-launch free-update skills explicitly named by official Bandai Namco material, while keeping the contemporaneous paid DLC attack count separate.

official_source.title: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2 DLC Pack Preview
official_source.scope: Official preview states the December 20 update included two explicitly named Awoken Skills—Kaioken times 10 for SSGSS Goku and Pure Progress for Hit—plus four new attacks; the separate first DLC Pack contained five new attacks.

mappings.basis: The official preview explicitly identifies the December 20 free update's new SSGSS Goku Awakened Skill as Kaioken times 10. The canonical Xenoverse 2 record is the character-only Super Saiyan Blue Kaioken identity; existing repository evidence distinguishes its normal and x10 stages.
The official preview explicitly identifies the December 20 free update's new Hit Awakened Skill as Pure Progress, matching the canonical Xenoverse 2 skill identity.

boundaries: The official source separates the free update from the first DLC Pack; the five DLC Pack attacks are not assigned to the free-update event.
The four additional free-update attacks are not individually named by this source, so no canonical skill IDs are inferred for them.
The December 20 release date is release provenance, not a game version/patch number.
No canonical skills.json mutation is required because both named skills already exist canonically.
Existing canonical identity and character-only classification are preserved.
next: Continue older DLC/free-update provenance cohorts with explicit official skill names or counts; do not infer unnamed attacks from character, reward order, or DLC proximity.
